items.name: 電梯門關閉
items.prompt:
Original 2D anime opening film, fine graphite-like line art, selectively painted cel shadows, muted watercolor backgrounds, cinematic 24fps animation. Reference image 1 = Yucheng: 26-year-old woman, short black bob with pale grey-blue tips, charcoal T-shirt, dark trousers, black lanyard, beige spiral sketchbook in hand. Reference image 2 = Yalin: 34-year-old woman, ash-brown shoulder-length hair, light grey-beige blazer, mist-grey top, LIGHT GREY straight trousers, off-white sneakers, holding a grey tablet. Keep both faces and outfits exactly as the references, adult proportions.

Scene: Office elevator lobby on a rainy day in Taipei, cool grey light. Camera is behind Yucheng, over her shoulder, two or three steps from a steel elevator whose doors are closing, leaving a narrowing vertical gap. Inside the elevator, Yalin stands in an ordinary side-facing stance looking down at her tablet, not noticing Yucheng, neutral expression, not smiling. Yucheng sees the gap narrowing and quickens one natural step forward, lanyard swinging and settling. The doors close into a thin vertical seam of light. Plausible floor distance and door geometry. Palette: desaturated blue-grey, graphite, steel reflections. No text, no dialogue, no friendly gesture.

At first her silhouette blends with the reflected city; as the camera slides, her outline separates clearly. Near the end she makes one small, alert turn of her head toward the corridor to the right; hair tips swing slightly after the head moves. Palette: desaturated rain blue, graphite, muted grey-green, cool glass reflections. Quiet, tense, restrained. No text, no other characters, no neon, no 3D look.
